hash_of: source text of reverb/qwen.py QwenClient.extract_release_facts (prompt and parser together)
changes: Ask for the column of the quarter being reported (reporting_period), not year-to-date or full-year columns
Require one contiguous quote: copy everything between start and end, never skip, reorder or join text from separate places
Period labels must be one contiguous piece of the quote, never assembled from separate table-header cells
Checker forgives line breaks versus spaces only, and cites the release's own exact text and offsets
Claims the release does not address are dropped and recorded instead of failing the reply; an ungrounded fact is dropped on its own instead of sinking the whole reply
learned_from: Costco Q4 FY2026 and STZ Q2 FY2027 failures, so rechecks of those two events are in-sample
out_of_sample_test: APLD Q1 FY2027, released after this revision was pushed; GitHub's activity log records the push time
note: Original Costco and STZ cross-check results stay as recorded. Scores always come from human-selected verbatim facts.
